title: Wu Zetian rules China as emperor
summary: In 690 Wu Zetian proclaimed her own Zhou dynasty in place of the Tang and crowned herself emperor, ruling until 705. She is the only undisputed female sovereign in China's history.
why: The only woman ever to take the title huangdi, emperor of China.

notes.problem: 'Rule China in her own name' is looser than the source; source: 'only woman in the history of China to assume the title huangdi'.
